about: Virtual tags. The account carries no cost allocation tags, so every (service, usage type) pair maps to a cost center by rule, the way a FinOps tool's virtual tags do. The first matching rule wins. A rule matches when the service is in its services list (if given) and the usage type matches one of its usage_types glob patterns (if given). A pair no rule matches is 'unallocated' and shows as its own line, so the allocated share on the dashboard says how much of the bill the rules explain. Edit, rebuild the exporter, and the whole history re-maps.
